# The Maity API contract

The REST contract hub, CLI and dashboard build against. Read with care.

## 6 Cards and their states

Cards are the board's unit of work. Each card has a status and a holder.It has a title, a body,a label,notes,links,a history and a place on the board.

`POST /projects/{owner}/{slug}/tasks` creates a card.
